statusLegend.done: Shared source or test coverage exists and no OpenClaw-only source or test paths were found for this domain.
statusLegend.partial: Both repos have this domain, but OpenClaw has additional source paths or tests to map.
statusLegend.missing: OpenClaw has this domain and CoreBlow has no shared source or test path for it.
statusLegend.intentionally_different: CoreBlow-only domain; keep only when it is a deliberate CoreBlow product or architecture surface.

behaviorDecisionLegend: A domain can remain partial while a specific shared path deliberately keeps CoreBlow behavior that differs from OpenClaw.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw grants default OpenAI-compatible operator scopes to shared-secret bearer requests.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow requires an explicitly declared operator.read scope for shared-secret bearer model-list requests.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Preserve least-privilege scope enforcement on the model discovery surface.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw validates OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_* env var compatibility scenarios.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps gateway auth env var contracts under COREBLOW_* naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid promoting OpenClaw-branded environment variables as CoreBlow public API.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps remote URL and insecure private WS opt-in under CoreBlow-branded configuration.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Preserve CoreBlow product naming on gateway connection and security knobs.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps insecure WS compatibility decisions on CoreBlow-branded configuration.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid adding OpenClaw-branded security bypass flags as canonical CoreBlow API.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw tests SecretRef precedence against OPENCLAW env variables.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow validates SecretRef precedence against CoreBlow config/env naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep auth precedence semantics without adopting OpenClaw public env names.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw rejects disallowed x-openclaw-model provider overrides.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses CoreBlow-branded request headers for provider override behavior.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Keep OpenAI-compatible behavior while avoiding OpenClaw-branded headers.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow request context channel headers use CoreBlow naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Message-channel request context is parity behavior, but public header naming is CoreBlow-native.

intentionalBehaviorDifferences.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw passes x-openclaw-message-channel through OpenAI-compatible HTTP.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow preserves message-channel behavior with CoreBlow header naming.
intentionalBehaviorDifferences.rationale: Avoid exposing OpenClaw-branded HTTP headers as CoreBlow contract.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw names the standalone ACP runtime extension with a tool-specific suffix.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow exposes the same runtime family as the canonical ACP extension and package surface.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Keep CoreBlow public plugin naming protocol-oriented while avoiding a tool-specific extension name.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw keeps a broader repo-local src/scripts test family for Control UI i18n helpers, docs-link audits, Codex CI prep, plugin-version sync, live-media planning, and test-project routing helpers.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps a smaller src/scripts test surface for repo-owned script entrypoints and moves adjacent responsibilities into the root scripts directory, UI and i18n runtime tests, or the separate docs workspace.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Preserve script coverage for active CoreBlow tooling without cloning OpenClaw's repo-local helper layout where those responsibilities now live in different modules or workspaces.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw uses legacy workflow runtime branding for the same local typed workflow surface.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow exposes the runtime as Workflow Shell with id, package, folder, SDK export, and tool name workflow-shell.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Keep the workflow runtime professional and CoreBlow-native while preserving behavior parity.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw keeps docs validation tests for channel examples, plugin snippets, install placeholders, and slash-command coverage inside the main repo under src/docs.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps the product docs surface in the dedicated docs workspace and validates it there, while the main repo only carries runtime docs links and docsPath metadata.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Preserve docs behavior and validation in the active docs stack without reintroducing a duplicate src/docs test family into the main CoreBlow repo.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw ships Voyage as a standalone extension that registers a memory embedding provider.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow registers Voyage as a built-in memory embedding provider from the memory-core extension.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Avoid loading two providers with the same id while keeping Voyage available through CoreBlow's consolidated memory provider architecture.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw ships Active Memory recall as a standalone extension that owns bounded recall config, memory tool guidance, and active memory runtime wiring.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow folds active memory behavior into the memory-core extension and the shared memory runtime slot instead of exposing a separate active-memory plugin package.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Keep the active memory backend, memory tools, prompt section, and runtime registration consolidated in CoreBlow's memory architecture rather than splitting a second memory plugin surface.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw ships Readability extraction as a standalone web-readability extension with a narrow extractor artifact.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps the same readability extraction behavior inside the built-in web-fetch runtime instead of exposing a separate plugin package.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Preserve behavior parity while keeping Readability on the hot web-fetch path and avoiding a duplicate plugin-only abstraction.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw keeps a dedicated src/web-fetch runtime for content extractors and plugin-owned web-fetch provider resolution.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow keeps the same behavior split across the built-in web-fetch tool runtime, runtime web-tool metadata resolution, and the Firecrawl web-fetch contract surface instead of introducing a separate src/web-fetch module family.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Preserve fetch behavior and Firecrawl credential parity while keeping provider-specific runtime wiring inside CoreBlow's existing tool, secrets, and extension boundaries.

matrix.notes: OpenClaw behavior is covered by a deliberate CoreBlow architecture placement.

intentionalDomainDifference.referenceBehavior: OpenClaw keeps an older UI app-settings shell where refreshActiveTab loads agents/files panels directly from a shared settings host.
intentionalDomainDifference.coreBlowDecision: CoreBlow uses the newer web control UI with a dedicated aiAgents tab, AgentsController, and agents view instead of the legacy app-settings refresh shell.
intentionalDomainDifference.rationale: Preserve the agents UI capability in CoreBlow's current web app architecture rather than reintroducing the deprecated OpenClaw settings-host pattern.
